overview: The Guild Hall Interior is where Shar Vahl’s artisan guilds gather to coordinate work, share knowledge, and manage commissions.
history: The guild hall was established to unify disparate artisan groups in Shar Vahl.
Master crafters began holding regular councils to set standards and prices.
Contract alcoves were added to formalize clan and royal commissions.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the hall was expanded with new demonstration platforms.
Arcane observers were invited to advise on complex enchanted works.
hooks: A dispute over a major commission escalates into a guild council event.
A demonstration of new techniques goes awry, causing minor hazards.
A royal request for ceremonial gear requires urgent coordination.
An apprentice uncovers an old pattern with unexpected properties.
